MEET YOUR NEW POINTER

A wave to the future.

No wearable. No special hardware. Just a webcam and one finger.

01

Let your camera say hello.

Click Enable camera and allow camera access. The first start downloads the MediaPipe model, so keep an internet connection available. Your live preview appears on the right.

02

One finger is all it takes.

Face your palm toward the camera, raise your index finger, and curl the other three fingers. Move your hand to guide the pointer. The preview is mirrored, like looking in a mirror.

03

Stay for a second. Go somewhere.

Hold the pointer over a button or page link. When its ring fills, it activates. Move off the button to click it again. Curl your index finger or take your hand out of view to release the pointer.

Give it a try
A few things for a smoother demo

Use even lighting, keep your whole hand in frame, and position yourself about an arm's length from the camera. Adjust hold time and smoothing in Preferences. Page links stay inside this demo; browser tabs and other applications are outside its control.
